recipes.name: Muffin Tin Spaghetti Nests (Using Leftover Pasta)
ingredients: Leftover pasta and sauce mixed together
1 egg per 3 packed cups of pasta ((see notes))
instructions: Mix the egg and pasta together.
Spray muffin tins with oil, then pack tightly with pasta. If you don't pack the pasta in, it will fall apart.
Bake until the pasta goes crunchy and golden on top - around 5 to 8 minutes.
Remove from oven and sprinkle on cheese, then return to oven until cheese melts.

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: The egg is what binds the pasta together. If you are using spaghetti, fettucine or another long pasta, then use 1 egg per 3 packed cups of pasta. If using penne or macaroni or similar, then use 1 egg per 4 packed cups of pasta.
